entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 22 CLI scenario configuration
entries.unit_contract: patients/hour or timestamped arrival schedule; select one representation per profile
entries.profile_use: Generate seeded arrivals from exactly one selected representation: a rate process or explicit relative schedule; preserve the schedule origin and source timestamp metadata.
entries.resolution: Generate seeded arrivals from one selected representation (rate process or explicit schedule); preserve exposure, cohort and timestamp origin/zone/precision for calibration, and assert no rate or distribution value.
open_gate: E0 arrival fixture must choose exactly one rate or occurrence-schedule representation and replay identical arrivals from the same run seed.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter
entries.unit_contract: interval bounds use ED-clock seconds; absolute instants retain original precision and explicit offset/zone and are normalized against the dataset UTC origin. Relative MVP schedules start at zero; checked conversion follows ADR-0004, and naive local timestamps or recurrence are rejected until a tested IANA zone adapter defines fold/gap handling.
entries.profile_use: generated calendar modifier for time-varying arrivals, not an observed target.
entries.resolution: Use only as an optional calendar modifier for time-varying arrivals; intervals use ED-clock seconds and instants retain explicit zone/offset and UTC origin. Disable naive local recurrence until IANA fold/gap handling is tested.
open_gate: Reject local recurrence without a declared IANA zone and fold/gap policy; allow relative schedules in the generic fixture.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter, with typed case attributes passed to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: structured categorical/time-varying profile; every numeric leaf declares units, categories, conditioning and denominator.
entries.profile_use: generate a declared surge intensity or occurrence schedule; do not imply a surge distribution or infer dependence from marginal counts.
entries.resolution: Use only when a profile explicitly selects a surge schedule or intensity; interval counts need exposure and baseline, and marginal data do not establish a surge distribution or burst dependence.
open_gate: A surge fixture must declare which demand modifiers change and keep each numeric leaf unit-bearing.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Generate a typed arrival-mode attribute only when the selected pathway branches on mode; preserve category coding and unknown arrivals.
entries.resolution: Generate a typed arrival-mode attribute only where a modeled route branches on mode; declare categories and unknowns, and do not imply universal categories or a duration target.
open_gate: When arrival-mode branching is enabled, reject an undeclared category or missing unknown-category rule.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter, with generated age-band case attributes passed to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: dimensionless proportions in [0,1] or explicitly declared patient counts; record age-band coding, denominator, conditioning and unknown category. Require mutually exclusive/exhaustive bands only when that representation claims complete coverage.
entries.profile_use: generate arrival case composition; observed age proportions are calibration targets only when cohort and denominator match, and marginal data do not define joint mix.
entries.resolution: Generate age composition with declared bands, denominator and unknown handling; observed proportions target only a matching arrival cohort, and marginals do not establish joint dependence.
open_gate: When age mix is enabled, validate age bands, denominator, conditioning and unknown handling.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter, with generated case-type attributes passed to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: dimensionless proportions in [0,1] or explicitly declared patient counts; declare category labels, denominator, conditioning and unknown handling.
entries.profile_use: generate a case-type/pathway selector; do not infer its relationship to age or acuity, or a joint distribution, from marginal observations.
entries.resolution: Generate a profile-defined case-type selector with declared categories and eligible-arrival denominator; no taxonomy or age/acuity relationship is implied, and later outcomes cannot be arrival attributes.
open_gate: When case-type mix is enabled, validate declared categories, denominator and unknown handling.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: dimensionless values in [0,1], denominators/conditioning explicit
entries.profile_use: Generate the initial triage acuity attribute using declared categories and denominator; treat later reassessments as separate events.
entries.resolution: Generate initial acuity using declared triage coding and arrival cohort; reassessment is a separate later state, and observed targets require matching scale/version and timing.
open_gate: The E2 patient fixture must assign scale-versioned initial acuity to every arrival and preserve reassessment as a separate event.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: dimensionless values in [0,1], denominators/conditioning explicit
entries.profile_use: Exclude from E2 until a named profile specifies joint dimensions, conditioning, denominator and linkage to supplied marginals for patient-level calibration.
entries.resolution: Defer from E2 until a named profile defines joint dimensions, conditioning, denominator and linkage to supplied marginals; patient-level linked attributes are required for calibration.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter, with incoming case attributes passed to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: declared referral category proportions with an arriving-patient denominator, or patient counts with an explicit count unit; include source and unknown category.
entries.profile_use: generate referral arrivals or a referral attribute as explicitly selected by the profile; never treat outgoing referral/disposition as this input.
entries.resolution: Represent incoming referral arrivals or an arrival attribute only when enabled; declare source and arriving-patient denominator, and keep outgoing referral/disposition in pathway outcomes.
open_gate: A referral-enabled fixture must distinguish incoming referral arrivals from outgoing referral outcomes.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter, with incoming transfer case attributes passed to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: declared transfer category proportions with an arriving-patient denominator, or patient counts with explicit count unit; include source boundary and unknown category.
entries.profile_use: represent arrivals entering the ED from an external transfer boundary; outgoing transfer disposition belongs to pathways.transfer.
entries.resolution: Represent incoming transfer arrivals at the external ED boundary with source and denominator; outgoing transfer disposition belongs to pathways.transfer.
open_gate: A transfer-arrival fixture must distinguish incoming transfer from outgoing disposition transfer.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: category labels and conditional proportions with explicit denominator; count-valued input declares patient count
entries.profile_use: Exclude from MVP until linkage key, lookback window, eligible denominator and new-arrival versus prior-history semantics are specified.
entries.resolution: Defer until linkage key, lookback window, eligible denominator and new-arrival versus prior-history semantics are defined; this is distinct from within-episode repeat loops.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: pathway state/transition data; numeric durations/probabilities appear as typed leaves
entries.profile_use: Configure registration as a distinct pathway state when the scenario models it; keep occurrence timing separate from chart-entry time.
entries.resolution: Configure registration as a distinct optional pathway state without imposing clinical content; map occurrence timestamps separately from chart-entry time and arrival-to-registration queueing.
open_gate: A registration-enabled fixture must emit distinct arrival and registration occurrence events.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: pathway state/transition data; numeric durations/probabilities appear as typed leaves
entries.profile_use: Configure triage and routing transitions with explicit category semantics; keep queue wait separate from active triage work.
entries.resolution: Configure triage and routing with explicit category semantics; keep waiting time separate from active triage work, and map observed events to the correct occurrence and triage scale.
open_gate: The triage fixture must separate queue entry, active triage work and triage completion events.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: pathway state/transition data; numeric durations/probabilities appear as typed leaves
entries.profile_use: Configure the assessment sequence and branches; bind observed targets to the correct assessment occurrence.
entries.resolution: Configure the assessment sequence and branches; bind observations to the correct task occurrence and do not treat arrival-to-assessment elapsed time as active work.
open_gate: The assessment fixture must separate active clinician work from queue and local movement.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: pathway state/transition data; numeric durations/probabilities appear as typed leaves
entries.profile_use: Configure diagnostic ordering and dependencies; represent order, procedure, result availability and review as separate modeled events when enabled.
entries.resolution: Configure diagnostic ordering and dependencies; distinguish order, procedure start, result availability and review events, including censoring and missing results.
open_gate: The diagnostic fixture must distinguish order, procedure, result availability and review events.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: pathway state/transition data; numeric durations/probabilities appear as typed leaves
entries.profile_use: Configure treatment pathway choices from modeled case state; keep treatment occurrence and active work distinct from elapsed time to treatment.
entries.resolution: Configure treatment choices from modeled case state; use treatment-specific occurrence anchors and keep queue, assessment and transit out of active treatment work.
open_gate: The treatment fixture must bind the declared task/resource class without inventing a regimen.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter maps this pathway into Kairos Track 03 Flow transitions
entries.unit_contract: typed pathway states/transitions, with any durations in seconds and probabilities dimensionless with explicit conditioning and denominator.
entries.profile_use: define observation entry, reassessment if applicable, and ED exit/return transitions; model inpatient boarding separately and keep observed events separate from generated pathway rules.
entries.resolution: Enable observation only in selected profiles; separate ED observation from inpatient boarding and map physical bed occupancy/release rather than assignment alone.
open_gate: An observation-enabled fixture must preserve ED observation occupancy separately from inpatient boarding.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter maps reassessment transitions into Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: typed trigger/transition data; numeric timing leaves use seconds and probability leaves declare conditioning and denominator.
entries.profile_use: specify the trigger, repeated-task occurrence semantics and bounded loop/termination behavior; observed reassessment events are separate targets with occurrence indices and eligible context.
entries.resolution: Enable reassessment only with a defined trigger and bounded repeat semantics; index repeated occurrences and keep observed events separate from generated rules.
open_gate: A reassessment loop fixture must enforce a trigger and bounded termination or occurrence limit.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter maps consult transitions into Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: typed pathway states/transitions; any durations use seconds and any probabilities declare conditioning and denominator.
entries.profile_use: state the trigger, destination, return or terminal transition and resource claim; do not imply a universal consult route or treat observed consult events as generated rules.
entries.resolution: Enable consult only where applicable; define trigger, destination and return/terminal transition, and distinguish request, acceptance, arrival and completion from active consult work.
open_gate: A consult-enabled fixture must declare trigger, destination, resource claim and return or terminal route.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: pathway state/transition data; numeric durations/probabilities appear as typed leaves
entries.profile_use: Configure discharge as a terminal route; distinguish decision, departure-ready and actual departure events.
entries.resolution: Configure discharge as a terminal route; distinguish decision, departure-ready and actual departure, with boarding/transport and unfinished censored cases kept separate.
open_gate: The discharge fixture must keep decision, departure-ready and physical departure as distinct events.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter maps admission behavior into Kairos Track 03 Flow and the declared finite bed-offer boundary
entries.unit_contract: typed decision and transition data, with duration leaves in seconds and probabilities carrying explicit conditioning/denominator.
entries.profile_use: keep admission decision, offer/acceptance, boarding occupancy, transport and realized admission/physical ED departure as distinct states or events; an admission decision does not release the ED resource.
entries.resolution: Keep admission decision, offer/acceptance, boarding, transport and physical ED departure distinct; admission decision does not release the occupied ED resource.
open_gate: The admission fixture must keep decision, finite bed offer, acceptance, boarding occupancy and physical ED departure distinct; bed offer alone cannot release the ED resource.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter maps outgoing transfer disposition into Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: typed destination/eligibility/transition data; numeric durations use seconds and probabilities declare conditioning and denominator.
entries.profile_use: define destination eligibility and the modeled completion boundary for an outgoing transfer; keep incoming transfer arrivals under demand.transfers and do not imply a full fleet or receiving-ward model.
entries.resolution: Model outgoing transfer only when enabled, with destination eligibility and completion boundary; incoming transfers use demand.transfers, and no fleet or receiving-ward model is implied.
open_gate: An outgoing-transfer fixture must declare destination eligibility and terminal boundary separately from incoming transfers.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: dimensionless values in [0,1], denominators/conditioning explicit
entries.profile_use: Enable abandonment only in selected profiles; distinguish its eligible risk set and departure reason from discharge and censoring.
entries.resolution: Enable abandonment only in selected profiles; define eligible risk set and time at risk, and distinguish it from discharge and right censoring.
open_gate: An abandonment-enabled fixture must define the eligible risk set and terminal reason separately from discharge and right censoring.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies conditional routing tables to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: dimensionless probabilities in [0,1], with a named decision point, conditioning state, eligible alternatives, denominator, allowed outcomes and normalization rule; identify deterministic versus sampled selection.
entries.profile_use: generate a branch choice conditional on state; calibration against observed choices requires the same eligible alternative set and decision-time state.
entries.resolution: Generate routing choices conditional on named state and eligible alternatives with explicit denominator/normalization; calibrate only against matching decision-time choices.
open_gate: A routing table fixture must declare decision state, eligible alternatives, denominator and normalization rule.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter maps enabled repeat edges into Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: typed loop edge and trigger, with numeric timing in seconds and any probabilities explicitly conditioned.
entries.profile_use: declare the loop edge, trigger, termination condition or maximum iterations and event accounting; observed loop counts are separate targets requiring occurrence indices and episode boundaries.
entries.resolution: Enable repeat edges only with a trigger and termination or iteration bound; retain occurrence indices, episode boundaries and unfinished/censored loops.
open_gate: A repeat-loop fixture must enforce a trigger and a finite iteration or termination rule.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Configure queue selection priorities only when the profile uses multiple queue classes; bind ordering and tie breaks to the reviewed queue contract.
entries.resolution: Use queue priorities only with multiple queue classes and the reviewed ordering/tie-break contract; realized service order alone does not identify a priority rule.
open_gate: For multiple queue classes, verify priority ordering and deterministic tie breaks against the reviewed queue contract.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies deadline constraints to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: relative limits in decimal seconds; absolute deadlines are explicit-offset instants tied to the dataset UTC origin and retain source precision. Apply ADR-0004 checked conversion to one-nanosecond u128 ticks; reject unsupported precision, negative/overflow values and naive local instants.
entries.profile_use: generated pathway threshold/constraint, distinct from an observed elapsed-time target.
entries.resolution: Use as a generated threshold, with relative seconds or explicit-offset absolute instant tied to UTC origin; define missed-deadline behavior and do not treat it as an elapsed-time distribution.
open_gate: Reject negative, overprecision, overflow and naive civil-time deadlines under ADR-0004.

entries.consumer: Proposed CareOps ED model/config; Kairos 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: no single scalar unit; every numeric leaf declares its unit and category coding
entries.profile_use: Configure only reviewed task-preemption behavior; keep staff-task interruption separate from patient or resource eviction.
entries.resolution: Represent reviewed task-preemption policy only; keep task interruption/suspend/resume distinct from patient or resource eviction and require queue-contract evidence.
open_gate: The preemption fixture must keep staff task interruption ancestry separate from patient/resource eviction and verify the reviewed Q lifecycle.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies active-work durations to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004 to one-nanosecond u128 ticks with exact fixed-value checks or the declared sampled-duration ceiling rule and precision/rounding metadata.
entries.profile_use: generative active task time; fit only from occurrence-mapped endpoints that isolate active work from setup, queue, transit and interruption/resumption, preserving source precision.
entries.resolution: Generate active task work only; fit from occurrence endpoints isolating setup, queue, transit and interruption/resumption, then apply ADR-0004 checked tick conversion.
open_gate: The intrinsic-work fixture must exclude queue, transit and boarding intervals and apply checked duration conversion.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies setup intervals to Kairos Track 03 Flow and the named task/resource occupancy model
entries.unit_contract: decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004 to one-nanosecond u128 ticks with checked exactness or declared sampled rounding.
entries.profile_use: identify the owning task/resource, setup start/end and whether capacity is occupied or setup precedes active work; fit only from setup-specific occurrence endpoints distinct from service, queue and transit.
entries.resolution: Enable setup only for a named task/resource and separate start/end; declare capacity occupancy and ordering relative to active work to prevent overlap or double counting.
open_gate: A setup fixture must name the task/resource and declare occupancy and setup start/end events.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies process/device turnaround to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004 to one-nanosecond u128 ticks with checked exactness or declared sampled rounding.
entries.profile_use: define the event pair and included external/ED components; keep report availability and clinician review separate and do not silently include ED queue or transit. Fit only to matching occurrence endpoints.
entries.resolution: Enable turnaround only with a defined event pair and included components; separate external/ED delay from queue/transit and keep report availability and clinician review distinct.
open_gate: A turnaround fixture must name included components and distinguish report availability from clinician review.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies report/review delay to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004 to one-nanosecond u128 ticks with checked exactness or declared sampled rounding; retain source event precision.
entries.profile_use: generate elapsed delay after the relevant diagnostic process; map observed targets to report-availability and review-occurrence endpoints, keeping order time and recorded/message time separate.
entries.resolution: Generate delay after the diagnostic process; map targets to report availability and review occurrence, keeping order, message and recorded timestamps separate.
open_gate: A report-review fixture must anchor result availability and review occurrence separately from recorded/message times.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies cleaning work to the reusable resource/location availability model consumed by Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004 to one-nanosecond u128 ticks with checked exactness or declared sampled rounding.
entries.profile_use: name the resource and map cleaning occurrence start/completion separately from patient departure, bed assignment and resource release; declare concurrency and avoid counting the same interval in task work and availability. Fit only from cleaning-specific endpoints.
entries.resolution: Tie cleaning to a named reusable resource and cleaning start/completion; separate patient departure, bed assignment and resource release, and declare concurrency to avoid double counting.
open_gate: A cleaning fixture must name the resource, cleaning start/completion and bed-ready event separately from patient departure.

entries.consumer: CareOps ED configuration adapter supplies a named handover task to Kairos Track 03 Flow
entries.unit_contract: decimal seconds converted under ADR-0004 to one-nanosecond u128 ticks with checked exactness or declared sampled rounding.
entries.profile_use: specify participants, occurrence start/end and overlap/concurrency treatment; keep ambulance arrival, offload and crew release as separate measures where modeled, and fit only from handover-specific anchors.
entries.resolution: Enable only as a named handover task with participants, occurrence start/end and overlap rule; keep ambulance arrival, offload and crew release as separate measures.
open_gate: A handover fixture must name participants, occurrence endpoints and overlap; distinguish ambulance arrival, offload and crew release.
